name: mcp-companion-pi-shim
description: Root shim so `pi install git:github.com/georgeharker/mcp-companion` finds the Pi extension under plugins/pi. Not published — the installable npm package is @geohar/pi-mcp-combiner (published from plugins/pi). Kept minimal: no dependencies, no "type", no "workspaces", so it stays invisible to combiner/pyproject.toml and to scripts/bump-version.sh.
